note: This page is the real registration wizard — individual, group and business, branching from one shared first step. Its interaction logic (step navigation, validation, the calls to this site's own cecf/v1 REST routes) is CODE, not content — see resources/js/registration.js and partials/cecf/registrationForm.blade.php, backed by App\Providers\CecfRegistrationServiceProvider. The registrationForm section below carries no step data of its own for that reason; only the surrounding phead/note copy is seeded here.

sections.heading: Registration form
sections.lead: For yourself, a group or a business. Free, and it stays free — a field officer will confirm everything with you afterwards.

sections.body: A group's registration fee is KES 500 per member — paid together as one amount, or by each member separately from their own account. An individual or business registration is also KES 500. Nothing is charged until you choose to pay.
